HACKER SPORTS FACILITY

Booking and Payment Terms

BY SAVING A PAYMENT CARD OR MAKING ANY PAYMENT IN THE HACKER SPORTS FACILITY APP, YOU AGREE TO THESE BOOKING AND PAYMENT TERMS, INCLUDING THE AUTHORIZATION TO CHARGE YOUR SAVED CARD IN SECTION 6 AND THE BINDING ARBITRATION AND JURY TRIAL WAIVER IN SECTION 15.

1. About These Terms

These Booking and Payment Terms (the "Terms") apply to every booking at Hacker Sports Facility, 3450 Centennial Rd., Sylvania, Ohio 43560 (the "Facility"), which is owned and operated by 3450 Centennial Rd LLC, an Ohio limited liability company (the "Owner," "we" or "us"). "You" means the member or guest who saves a card, makes a payment, or books or joins a booking.

These Terms work together with the Participant Agreement, Assumption of Risk, Release and Waiver of Liability, Indemnity, and Arbitration Agreement (the "Participant Agreement") that every person must sign before using the Facility. If these Terms and the Participant Agreement conflict on safety, risk or liability, the Participant Agreement controls.

2. Membership and Access

  • The Facility is private. Only people approved by the Owner may book or use it. We may approve or decline any membership or guest request, and may suspend or revoke any membership at any time in our sole discretion.
  • Every person on a booking must be an approved member or approved guest and must have signed the current Participant Agreement. Guests added by a member stay pending until we approve them.
  • Each booking receives a door access code that works only at the front door, and only from 15 minutes before the booking starts until 10 minutes after it ends. You may share it only with the people on your booking.
  • Membership is personal and cannot be transferred.

3. Bookings

  • Courts are booked in 2-hour blocks between 6:00 AM and 10:00 PM. You may book Court 1, Court 2 or both courts together.
  • Bookings may be made up to 7 days in advance. Each member may make up to 3 bookings per calendar week (Monday through Sunday). A booking of both courts counts as one booking. Being a guest on someone else's booking does not count toward your limit.
  • Every booking is a request until we approve it. We may decline any request. The Owner may reserve times for private use.
  • We may change the booking hours, block length, advance booking period and weekly limits at any time. Changes are shown in the app and do not affect bookings already approved.

4. Fees

  • Court fees are currently $20 per court per hour: $40 for one court for a 2-hour block, and $80 for both courts.
  • We may change our fees with notice in the app. A fee change does not affect a booking that has already been approved.
  • Fees include any applicable taxes, unless the app shows otherwise.

5. How Payment Works

  • Splitting the cost. By default, the booking fee is split equally among all players on the booking. When it doesn't divide evenly, the extra cents go to the first shares. The booker may instead choose to pay for everyone.
  • When cards are charged. Each player's share is charged to their saved card about 24 hours before the booking starts. If a booking is approved less than 24 hours before it starts, shares are charged when it is approved. Players may also choose to pay their share earlier.
  • Changes before charging. If players are added or removed more than 24 hours before the start, the shares are recalculated and the players are notified.
  • Payment processor. Payments are processed by Stripe, Inc. Your card details are entered on Stripe's secure page and stored by Stripe, not by the Owner. Stripe's own terms and privacy policy also apply to your use of its service.
  • Receipts. A receipt is emailed to you for each charge.

6. Authorization to Charge Your Saved Card

When you save a payment card in the app, you authorize the Owner, through Stripe, to charge that card, without asking you again each time, for:

  • (a) your share of each booking you make or join, at the times described in Section 5;
  • (b) if you are the booker, any player's share that is still unpaid when the booking starts, including the share of any guest who has not been approved by then (see Section 7);
  • (c) late cancellation and no-show charges under Section 8.

Your saved card will not be charged for anything else without your separate consent. This authorization lasts until you remove your card in the app or your membership ends. A saved card is required to make a booking, and to join a booking on which you pay a share. If a charge fails, we will email you a link to complete the payment, and you may not be able to make new bookings until it is paid.

7. The Booker's Responsibility

The person who makes a booking (the "booker") is responsible for the full booking fee. If any player's share is still unpaid when the booking starts, it is charged to the booker's saved card. The booker receives an email about any unpaid shares about 10 minutes before the start. We are notified each time a player fails to pay, and failing to pay may lead to suspension or revocation of membership.

8. Cancellations, Changes and No-Shows

  • More than 24 hours before the start: the booker may cancel or reschedule to another open time at no charge. Players may be removed at no charge.
  • Within 24 hours of the start: the booking is not refundable, and each player's share is charged as scheduled.
  • Credits at the Owner's discretion: if you cancel within 24 hours for a good reason, you may ask the Owner to waive the charge. If the Owner agrees, the amount is returned as a credit, not as a refund to your card.
  • No-shows: if you don't attend a booking, your share is charged and no credit is given.
  • Leaving early or arriving late does not reduce the fee.
  • If we cancel: if we have to cancel your booking (for example, because of a facility problem), you will receive a full refund, or a credit if you prefer.

9. Credits

  • Credits are applied automatically to your next booking share.
  • Credits have no cash value, cannot be transferred and cannot be redeemed for cash.
  • Credits expire 12 months after the date they are issued. Any unused credit is forfeited when it expires. The app shows each credit's expiration date, and we will email you a reminder about 30 days before a credit expires.
  • Credits are also forfeited if your membership is revoked for violating these Terms or the Participant Agreement.

10. Refunds

Except as stated in Section 8, payments are not refundable. Approved refunds are returned to the original card and usually appear within 5 to 10 business days, depending on the card issuer.

11. Payment Questions and Disputed Charges

If you believe a charge is wrong, please contact us at hackersportsfacility@gmail.com before contacting your card issuer, and we will work with you to resolve it. If a chargeback is filed without first contacting us, we may suspend your membership until it is resolved.

12. Communications

By joining, you agree to receive emails about your membership, bookings, sign-in codes, door access codes, payments and receipts, and changes to these Terms. Please keep your contact information current in the app.

13. Privacy

We collect the information you give us (such as your name, email, phone number, emergency contact, date of birth and signed waiver), your booking and payment history, door access records and security camera recordings. We use this information only to operate, secure and manage the Facility. We do not sell it. Payment card details are held by Stripe. Other players on a booking see only your name.

14. Changes to These Terms

We may update these Terms. The current version is always available in the app. When we make a material change, we will notify you by email or in the app, and the new version applies to bookings made, and payments taken, after that notice. Saving a card or making a payment after the notice confirms that you accept the updated Terms.

15. Disputes, Arbitration and Jury Trial Waiver

These Terms, and any claim, controversy or dispute arising out of them, are governed by and will be construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Ohio. Section 15 of the Participant Agreement (Binding Arbitration, Class Action Waiver and Jury Trial Waiver) applies to any dispute arising out of or relating to these Terms, any booking or any payment, and is incorporated into these Terms. This means disputes will be resolved by binding individual arbitration, not in court, and you knowingly, voluntarily and unconditionally waive any right to a jury trial, except for qualifying small claims. If you opted out of arbitration under the Participant Agreement within 30 days of signing it, that opt-out also applies to these Terms.
